them.zh: Agent Toolkit for AWS 做的

steps.en: Install the core plugin from Anthropic's default marketplace
steps.zh: 从 Anthropic 默认市场装核心插件

steps.en: Adds 14 core skills, a secret-blocking hook and a local proxy to the hosted AWS MCP Server
steps.zh: 装上 14 个核心 skill、拦密钥的 hook，以及连托管服务器的本地代理

steps.en: Sign in so the proxy can sign calls with your IAM identity
steps.zh: 登录 AWS，让代理用你的 IAM 身份签名

steps.en: Ask for the AWS job in plain words
steps.zh: 用大白话交代这件 AWS 的活

steps.en: Loads the matching skill and checks current AWS docs before acting
steps.zh: 加载匹配的 skill，动手前先查最新 AWS 文档

steps.en: Runs the calls or scripts under your role, tagged as agent traffic in IAM and CloudTrail
steps.zh: 用你的角色执行调用或脚本，IAM 和 CloudTrail 里都标为 agent

value.en: The agent follows AWS's current procedures instead of stale training data, and its actions are separable from yours in IAM policy and audit logs
value.zh: agent 按 AWS 当前的做法干活而不是凭过时记忆，它的操作在 IAM 策略和审计日志里能和你的分开
